description: Documentation coverage checks for ISO 25010 software product quality characteristics. Checks whether quality requirements across performance, reliability, usability, security, maintainability, compatibility, and portability are documented in the project artifacts.

rules.title: Performance Efficiency
rules.description: Performance requirements such as response time and throughput must be specified.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for response time SLAs, throughput targets, or performance acceptance criteria.
rules.recommendation: Document performance requirements such as response time SLAs, throughput, and load handling.

rules.title: Reliability & Availability
rules.description: Availability and fault-tolerance requirements must be defined.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for availability SLAs, uptime targets, fault tolerance, or RTO/RPO definitions.
rules.recommendation: Specify availability SLAs, fault tolerance mechanisms, and recovery objectives (RTO/RPO).

rules.title: Usability
rules.description: Usability requirements and UX expectations must be documented.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for usability requirements, UX guidelines, or target user definitions.
rules.recommendation: Document usability requirements, target users, and UX design guidelines.

rules.title: Security Requirements
rules.description: Security requirements including encryption and data protection must be documented.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for security requirements, encryption standards, TLS requirements, or secure-by-default policies.
rules.recommendation: Document security requirements including encryption, data protection, and secure communications.

rules.title: Maintainability
rules.description: Code quality and maintainability expectations must be defined.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for code quality standards, test coverage targets, or architectural guidelines.
rules.recommendation: Document code quality expectations, test coverage targets, and architectural guidelines.

rules.title: Compatibility & Integration
rules.description: Browser, device, and integration compatibility must be specified.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for browser/device compatibility requirements or external integration constraints.
rules.recommendation: Specify browser/device compatibility requirements and external integration constraints.

rules.title: Portability & Deployment
rules.description: Deployment targets and infrastructure requirements must be documented.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for deployment targets, infrastructure requirements, or containerization mentions.
rules.recommendation: Document deployment targets, infrastructure requirements, and portability constraints.
